headline: Kenya Diaspora Remittances Dip Marginally to $4.20 Billion as US Inflows Soften
summary: Total remittance inflows to Kenya dropped 0.32% to $4.20 billion according to Central Bank data. US-based inflows declined, now accounting for less than half of total diaspora money.
why: Remittances are a critical source of foreign exchange and consumer income for Kenya.
